en.bilal-muhammad: The Messenger of Allah (s) said: In Paradise there is a gate called “the Gate of the Strivers (bab al-mujahidin).” They will go to it. When it is open, they will be armed with their swords, and they will be gathered at the stand while the angels welcome them.
Whoever abandons jihad, Allah will gown him in humiliation from himself, poverty in his livelihood, and the effacement of his religion.
Surely, Allah has given glory to my Nation through the hooves of horses and the posts of spears.
